rationale: The current implementation silently returns None when instance.pk is None, which disables logging for unsaved instances and creates a security logging failure. This change restores explicit error handling by raising a ValueError, ensuring that audit logging attempts on invalid/unsaved instances are properly signaled rather than silently ignored.
patch:
--- a/wagtail/models/audit_log.py
+++ b/wagtail/models/audit_log.py
@@ -112,7 +112,7 @@ class BaseLogEntryManager(models.Manager):
         """
 
         if instance.pk is None:
-            return None
+            raise ValueError("Cannot log action for unsaved instance")
 
         data = kwargs.pop("data", None) or {}
         title = kwargs.pop("title", None)
